prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of change because each kind has only been tested once.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, notification: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +7.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path screen using a spotlight layout that focuses on one onboarding path at a time with clear visual highlights. (why: Path selection takes a high mean duration of 514s and converting 76.8%; a spotlight layout reduces cognitive load.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Interactive personality companion pitch on app intro: Update the story screen copy to highlight how virtual pets interact with your daily desktop environment. (why: Clarifies desktop app capabilities upfront before users commit to choosing an onboarding path.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Split layout redesign with account benefits on sign in: Redesign the sign-in screen into a split layout showing desktop pet cloud sync benefits beside sign-in options. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets when re-authenticating.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet sync restore hint on sign in screen: Add an explicit hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in restores existing pets and saved progress. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets from users confused about pet state resets when logging back in.)
4: [adoption, reorder] Move sign in after pet adoption certificate: Reorder the flow so users create and adopt their pet before signing in to save their progress. (why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point (60.9%); delaying account creation until after pet creation builds intent.)
5: [adoption, layout] Stage layout display for adoption certificate screen: Change the adoption certificate screen to a stage layout showcasing the completed pet certificate prominently. (why: Improves visual celebration during adoption stage where users spend median 89s / mean 1017s.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desk environment sound player on waiting screen: Add an ambient sound player component on the waiting screen so users can listen to cozy desk audio while generation runs. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s; audio relaxation keeps users engaged.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop ready notification toggle on waiting screen: Enable a system desktop notification alert option on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; users minimize the window and benefit from an automatic tray alert when done.)
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop control checklist flow on home welcome screen: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist teaching how to hide, drag, and talk to the pet. (why: 3 support tickets specifically reported post-onboarding confusion around controlling and hiding pets on desktop.)
